item.title: Tamayura Mirai
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Azurite
  • 発売日: 2019-05-31
  • スコア: 7.38/10 (532 人評価)
  • 日本語名: タマユラミライ
  • 英語名: Tamayura Mirai

あらすじ

There is a girl, searching for something she lost…

In the town of Fukano, the air smells otherworldly. Long ago, humans and other spirits—the sorts of creatures we called youkai—lived together on this enchanted soil. Even now Fukano is still full of strange stories, of mystical entities and mysterious forces.

Kamikake Yukina has come back to this town with a friend in tow.

あらすじ

Jouichi has been constantly moving and changing schools because of his parent’s work, so he never really made many friends nor had a girlfriend. A few years ago, one of his best friends committed suicide. He never really understood the truth behind it and hoped to solve it one day.

item.description:

  • ブランド: Azurite
  • 発売日: 2016-12-22
  • スコア: 7.470000000000001/10 (154 人評価)
  • 日本語名: シンソウノイズ ～受信探偵の事件簿～
  • 英語名: Shinsou Noise Jushin Tantei no Jikenbo

あらすじ

This is the debut game for Azurite.

Shizunomiya is a suburban town nestled on the outskirts of a bustling metropolis. The urban side of the town is quite developed, adorned with contemporary landmarks, while the seaside offers a stark contrast with its untouched nature. Shizunomiya Academy, a central institution in this town, is where the athletic types find solace in the expansive nearby park. The more urban-spirited students venture into the city after school to indulge in activities befitting their age.

item.title: One~san Day☆by☆Day
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Azurite
  • 発売日: 2004-03-26
  • スコア: なし (1 人評価)
  • 日本語名: おね～さんDAY☆BY☆DAY
  • 英語名: One~san Day☆by☆Day

あらすじ

Main character lives alone and attends art lessons at a vocational school. One day a cousin suddenly arrives to help him around the house. Protagonist has a faint memory of a loving sister doing the house chores, so he reluctantly lets her in. But then four more girls arrive saying absolutely the same. Who of them is his real cousin from the past? His life turns in a mess while he tries to figure it out.
